set.text: SHOP STREET · 2:00 PM. Sunny. Vending machines hum. Nanda pulls you into a shop. You are here to buy her groceries.
We are here to shop. You buy what is on my list: carrots, eggs, three cups. And you. ♡
We walk out of the curry shop. It is 3:40 PM. Lunch is done. Now we walk to her station.
4:30 PM. We walked a long way. Now we are at her station. She takes your hand. 'Now we go to MY home. On MY train.'
The station is full. Everyone is going home.
